title: measuretwice canonical hashing fixture set (v0)
description: Machine-checkable companion to hashing.md. Defines the hash domains and the record shapes for shared conformance fixtures. The Rust core is the authority. Fixtures pin wrapper behavior to it.

string_rules.description: Length counting and matching fixtures for the exact rules.

hash_domain.description: Hash domain from hashing.md. The domain tag separates digests of the same canonical content under different kinds.

value.description: The complete hashed content inside the domain boundary, before canonicalization. Any JSON value that the boundary admits.

canonical.description: Expected canonical form of value, as hashing.md defines it. One line, no whitespace between tokens.

content_hash.description: Expected SHA-256 of the domain tag, one zero byte, and canonical.

rule.description: Rule under test. Same names as the definition contract.

parameter.description: Rule parameter. An integer for maxLength. A nonempty string for includes and excludes.

input.description: The one string input under test.

length.description: Expected code point count of input. Required for maxLength fixtures.

outcome.description: Expected rule outcome. Exact rules produce pass or fail only.
